Architecture

Attention Is All You Need

The Transformer replaced recurrence with attention in a sequence-to-sequence architecture.

Ashish Vaswani and colleagues

The contribution

The paper introduced an encoder-decoder architecture built around attention mechanisms, with positional information to represent sequence order. Translation experiments demonstrated strong results while allowing greater parallelization during training than recurrent approaches.

What this does not establish

The original study focused on sequence transduction. The title does not establish that attention alone is sufficient for every kind of intelligence.

Why this date?

The first arXiv submission was 12 June 2017, not 2022.

This entry follows the linked publication. Read the source and date conventions.
